full_page.content:
1951, January 22
The following is a faithful transcription of the handwritten orig- inal by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O.F.M. Cap.
ST. FELIX FRIARY Route 8 HUNTINGTON, INDIANA
Blessed be God in all His designs!
January 22, 1951
God bless you Dear Father Edward and guide you in His privileged service.
I just read the photo you sent me of our dear Father M. E. Joachim's tomb-marker and, sitting here with my two feet on another chair am using it as a writing desk. Deo gratias.
I've not said holy Mass since last Thursday. The skin-burns I wrote you about last week (if it got off), started the eczema activity again - after I'd had a Dr. Stan Casey treat the former. He sent me to a skin- specialist in Ft. Wayne, Dr. Mollairy, who stresses with treatment, "feet up. ' I would have offered holy Mass yesterday but Fr. Guardian thought better keep to Dr. 's orders. So that will probably mean a week or so before I'm on my feet again properly. Thanks be to God is gives me comparatively little pain or itch; so that time does not hang so painfully as it might otherwise.
